verdict.rationale: Temporal's worker-performance docs mention tuning Workers and Task Queue processing to 'manage resources effectively,' which implies some concurrency control at the task-queue/worker level, but there is no evidence of explicit per-key or per-tenant rate limiting/concurrency caps as described in the story. Missing for 10: documented per-workflow concurrency limits, per-key/tenant rate limiting primitives, and any hands-on confirmation of tenant isolation under load.
